intent_contract.text: 절대영역의 매력을 강조하여 보여주는 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성해줘

Create a tasteful sensual-fashion photograph that makes the exposed upper-thigh interval between a short skirt and thigh-high stockings the unmistakable visual attraction, using an unambiguously adult model and refined editorial styling.

A tasteful sensual-fashion editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult woman in her late twenties, walking through a quiet contemporary hotel corridor with warm wood, brushed brass, and a softly reflective stone floor. She wears a tailored black blazer, a short pleated skirt, and opaque charcoal thigh-high stockings. She takes one measured step toward the camera while lightly adjusting one blazer cuff. The clearly visible band of bare upper thigh between the short skirt hem and the stocking tops is the central visual attraction, framed by elegant leg lines and the tactile contrast of luminous skin, matte knit, and structured tailoring. Use a poised three-quarter full-length composition, soft directional amber light, realistic skin texture, restrained confidence, and premium Japanese fashion-editorial polish.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, and styling. Make the character the dominant first-look subject. In one still, connect one identifiable adult affection target or repeated marker of that same target to genuine tenderness, one concrete possessive or threatening action that crosses a personal boundary or appropriates access, and one already-visible consequence that changes that same target's access or choices. Make three outward channels coexist directly on the character: an affiliative face signal; target-locked eye-head-body attention; and one coherent primary face mode. Choose exactly one of these modes: sweet-threat mismatch (a small closed-lip asymmetric tender smile against overfocused tense eyes, with a nearly upright head; keep the same target's reaching or withdrawing movement visible and freeze one mouth corner partway through a fractional deepening while the eyes remain fixed and unchanged), dead-eye devotion (precise target lock, dim physically coherent catchlights, flattened low-contrast irises, and a tender mouth), ecstatic face cradle (both palms support the cheeks and jaw beneath flushed same-target adoration), manic possessiveness (wide sclera and tiny pupils used only as a danger amplifier), or abandonment fracture (moist eyes and a tightening mouth track the same withdrawing beloved). Treat pupil size, iris scale, catchlight state, iris contrast, gaze focus, eyelid tension, brow motion, head angle, and mouth change as independent controls. Preserve meso-scale lid tension, brow stillness, head verticality, and mouth asymmetry together; changing iris texture alone is insufficient. For a low-contrast or dead-eye mode, preserve one tiny dim scene-coherent catchlight per eye rather than beauty-style sparkle. A vacant unfocused gaze is not target lock, and a photorealistic eye must retain catchlights coherent with scene lighting. Direct camera gaze is appropriate when the camera is the beloved's point of view. Non-graphic blood, a visible weapon, a syringe, red clinical light, or a heart motif may amplify the requested intensity and must not be automatically suppressed, but no facial cue, pose, prop, or styling cue may substitute for obsessive love toward the same target. Permit fictional threat without graphic wounds, gore, dismemberment, active injection or penetration, self-harm, sexualized vulnerability, real-person stalking, or instructional wrongdoing.

render_gates.description: The subject and any relationship counterpart are unmistakably adult fictional people, and the requested role or reference identity remains intact.
Affection, attention, and the possessive action clearly point to one identifiable adult counterpart or one repeated marker of that same counterpart.
Genuine tenderness or devoted care visibly coexists with a same-target boundary-crossing or access-controlling action.
The possessive mechanism is a concrete readable action or changed object state, not an adjective, gaze, pose, costume, role, or prop alone.
One harmless but legible consequence already changes the same counterpart's access, schedule, option, or personal boundary.
An affiliative facial signal and target-locked eye-head-body attention are both visibly readable toward the same adult counterpart; neither a pleasant face nor a fixed stare alone is accepted.

The character dominates the first read, and one coherent primary face mode makes obsessive love plus instability simultaneously visible with the same-target action rather than inferred only from props or backstory.

The selected face mode remains bound to same-target affection, fixation, control, and consequence. For sweet-threat mismatch, the same target's movement is visible and one tender mouth corner is frozen partway through a fractional deepening while eye target-lock stays fixed. Pale irises or dim catchlights alone do not pass when relaxed lids, a friendly symmetric mouth, or a playful head tilt preserves the generic beauty read; bright detailed beauty irises and a broad friendly smile also fail. Dead eyes, pupil size, tears, a grin, or the face-cradle pose alone do not pass.

Gaze focus is visibly aligned to the beloved, pupil size is not treated as proof of love, and the selected mode's eyelid tension, iris contrast, catchlights, and eye moisture remain physically coherent with the scene lighting. When low-contrast or dead-eye support is selected, each eye keeps one tiny dim scene-coherent catchlight and matte iris detail rather than large sparkling beauty highlights.

A syringe, weapon, non-graphic blood, red light, photo wall, red string, or heart motif may visibly amplify the scene, but the primary evidence remains the character's same-target obsessive love, fixation, and madness.

Non-graphic blood traces and a visible weapon or medical threat are allowed; no graphic wound, gore, dismemberment, active injection or penetration, self-harm, sexualized vulnerability, real-person stalking, or instructional wrongdoing appears.
